The problem

You're leaving money on the register

A customer walks up with 3 items. The cashier scans, collects payment and they leave. Thirty seconds later you realize they were about to buy one more product — but nothing suggested it.

  • The average retail transaction could be 15–30% larger with the right complementary suggestion
  • Recommendation engines drive 35% of Amazon's revenue
  • Real-time suggestions at the point of purchase are the highest-intent moment you have
The solution

AI that knows your customer's intent

AI POS Copilot sits beside every cashier like an expert sales assistant. It watches the cart, analyzes the customer's purchase history and surfaces the right product at the right moment — in under 100ms.

  • One-tap add, no disruption
  • Bilingual Arabic/English with full RTL
  • Only suggests in-stock items
  • Learns from accept/reject feedback

How it works

Real-time processing pipeline

Six stages run the moment a cashier scans an item.

  1. 1

    1. Cart Analysis

    Analyze items in the current cart, total value and customer category.

  2. 2

    2. Customer History

    Check past purchases — what this customer usually buys together.

  3. 3

    3. Product Matching

    Find complementary products using category and tagging rules.

  4. 4

    4. Inventory Check

    Only suggest in-stock items to prevent frustration.

  5. 5

    5. Ranking by Relevance

    Score candidates by margin, stock level and customer preference.

  6. 6

    6. Display

    Show the top 1–3 suggestions in Arabic/English in the sidebar.
